# BB00312: Tawqi'a haykal {.unnumbered}

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are prostrate before Him.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are His worshippers.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are unto Him devoutly obedient.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. He giveth life and causeth to die, then causeth to die and giveth life again; and He is the Living One Who dieth not. In His grasp is the Kingdom of all things, and unto Him shall all return.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth to die, then causeth to die and giveth life again; and He is the Living One Who dieth not. In His grasp is the Kingdom of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command, "Be", and it is.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are before Him humble in awe.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are before Him lowly and submissive.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All stand before Him (in obedience and service).

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are mindful of Him.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All praise and thank Him.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All hold whatsoever they hold but through Him.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth to die, then causeth to die and giveth life again; and He is the Living One Who dieth not. In His grasp is the Kingdom of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command, "Be", and it is.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are at work for Him and in His path.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command, in the beginning and in the end, and unto Him shall all be brought back.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are in His presence.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All are gathered unto Him.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: All attain through Him to victory and succour.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the sovereignty and the Kingdom, in the beginning and in the end. He bringeth into being whatsoever He willeth through His command, for He hath ever been powerful over all things.

In the Name of God, the Most Inaccessible, the Most Holy.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the All-Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the All-Glorious, the All-Holy.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the All-Holy.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the All-Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth to die, then causeth to die and giveth life again; and He is the Living One Who dieth not. In His grasp is the Kingdom of all things; He bringeth into being whatsoever He willeth by His command, "Be", and it is.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the All-Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the All-Glorious, the All-Holy.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the All-Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the All-Glorious, the All-Holy.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command, in the beginning and in the end, and unto Him shall all be raised up.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the All-Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the Protector, the Well-Beloved.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the One, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He, the One, the Inaccessible, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Glorious, the Most Exalted.

In the Name of God, the Most Luminous, the Most Luminous.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all attain to dominion.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are invested with glory.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are adorned with beauty.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are brought to precedence.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are illumined.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are caused to speak.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all attain unto victory and felicity.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are given sway and authority.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are honoured.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are exalted.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are answered.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are given to know.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are made to appear.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are hidden.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are well-pleased and content.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all boast and glory.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all make things subservient.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. Say: It is through Him that all are raised up.

"Whose is the kingdom this day?" Say: It is God's, the One, the Luminous. Say: On that Day the kingdom shall be God's, the One, the Victorious. Say: On that Day the kingdom shall be God's, the One, the Creator. Verily, on that Day the kingdom shall be God's, the One, the Manifest.

God beareth witness that there is none other God but He. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth to die, then causeth to die and giveth life again; and He is the Living One Who dieth not. In His grasp is the Kingdom of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command, for He hath ever been powerful over all things.

Say: On that Day the kingdom shall be God's, the One, the All-Subduing. And naught is there that escapeth His knowledge—not before nor after, neither in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth nor in what lieth between them—for He hath ever been, of all things, all-knowing. Say: On that Day the kingdom shall be God's, the One, the All-Constraining.
